redistribution_classes.meaning: AGID-created metadata and non-production fixtures only.
Public official pages or documents used as validation receipts; access does not imply bulk redistribution rights.
A dataset-specific official CC BY 4.0 release whose resource, attribution, schema, coverage, validity, and digest are pinned.
Request-based, credentialed, rate-limited, contract, or operational API data retained only as permitted.
Restricted, sensitive, foreign-routing, or unclear-rights data may detect discrepancies but cannot become authoritative public geometry or address output.

sources.provider: Cyprus Post / Department of Postal Services
sources.production_scope: Pinned annual Cyprus Post directory and street/range resources with Greek/English names, four-digit text, municipality/community, district, serving office when present, temporal scope, CC BY 4.0 attribution, and digest.

sources.provider: Cyprus Post / Department of Postal Services
sources.production_scope: Request-approved API fields only, retaining query class, response schema, result scope, capture time, service state, credentials policy, rate limits, retention terms, and digest.
Pinned UPU Cyprus addressing guide used for four-digit syntax, domestic/international presentation, CY- prefix, placement, and examples only.

sources.provider: Cyprus Department of Lands and Surveys (DLS)
sources.production_scope: Pinned CC BY 4.0 DLS INSPIRE Addresses release with feature and relationship identifiers, locator/thoroughfare/postal descriptor, point semantics, coverage, temporal vintage, CRS, attribution, schema, and digest.

sources.provider: Cyprus Department of Lands and Surveys (DLS)
sources.production_scope: Pinned CC BY 4.0 DLS INSPIRE Buildings release with feature identifier, geometry class, source layer, municipality/community partition, coverage, vintage, CRS, attribution, schema, and digest.

sources.provider: Cyprus Department of Lands and Surveys (DLS)
sources.production_scope: Pinned CC BY 4.0 DLS administrative-unit release with hierarchy level, identifiers, names, notes, coverage, territorial-policy annotation, vintage, CRS, attribution, schema, and digest.
Pinned CC BY 4.0 CYSTAT postal-sector statistical layer with census/reference date, methodology, population scope, coverage, CRS, attribution, schema, and digest.
Pinned legal text and policy version used only to keep EU-law application/effective-control context separate from sovereignty, postal routing, operator coverage, and feature geometry.

artifact_partitions.rule: Cyprus Post directory, street/range, locality and special-code assertions retain four-digit text, source resource, capture time, rights and digest; UPU prefix and syntax never create allocation.
API access, outages, post-office operation, routing and delivery status are time-stamped operational assertions separate from assignment, geometry, country, control and historical validity.
DLS address identity, point, locator, building relation and parcel relation retain distinct identifiers and semantics; a relationship table is not replaced by containment or proximity.
DLS building features retain layer, partition, geometry and vintage; exact address display requires an explicit relationship, common identifier or reviewed crosswalk.
CYSTAT postal sectors are labelled official statistical geometry with census/reference date and never Cyprus Post official perimeters.
Rights-cleared street/range and address membership may create a versioned uncertainty-bearing surface with method, members, exclusions, validity and lineage; it is never official geometry.

CY identity, Republic-government effective-control/service area, Green Line, CYGL/TRNC/SBA feature class and foreign routing remain separately pinned. Postal, API, address, building or administrative evidence never auto-reclassifies them.
Addressees, residents, owners, rightsholders, occupants, title records, phones, credentials, delivery instructions and protected cadastral fields never enter public artifacts.
Non-production fixture metadata only; never promotion evidence.
